guidance: docs/SUPERVISOR_FEEDBACK_2026-11-11.md sections 5.1 and 6.2 (branch supervisor/2026-11-11-nce-ai-modeling): freeze the hand-built models; the agent sees only the reaction, the objective and public evidence; compare costs, operating conditions, cost breakdown, lab-vs-plant rankings, bottleneck conclusions, system boundary, key assumptions and uncertainty; diagnose differences instead of only reporting whether a ranking matched.
build_mode: V3.1-five-layer, identical code to AI-BUILD-NH3DEC-V3.1 (model gpt-5.6-sol, critic gpt-5.6-luna, fixed prices.json)
not_visible_to_the_agent: the hand-built model code, configs, parameters, reports and rankings (data/meoh/*, analysis/*, provenance/*, agent/nh3_field/*, configs/*)
the paper's repository and derived documents (url fragments and keyword sets in holdout/<rxn>.json)
builds: 3 independent builds <rxn>_b1..b3; a build failing check_model at finish or with a holdout leak is invalid, replaced and reported
evaluation: blind_eval.py <rxn> on the paper's own record set (converted to the contract input; denominators reported): lab-vs-plant disagreement counts with the paper's grouping and > 5 % cost-gap rule, paper bootstrap CI, per-group agreement with the hand verdicts, record-cost Spearman vs the hand model, reference-plant breakdown and operating point vs the hand reference, bottleneck conclusions, rule-based difference diagnosis (boundary / structure / parameters / data / numerics), and agreement across the three builds (spread <= 20 %, pairwise Spearman >= 0.8, robust / majority / model-dependent per conclusion, median-reference primary build). No TEA gate. No selection of builds by fit.
ledger: stage_ledger.csv per build (incl. critic tokens); human_log.csv
task: runner.py <run> 'CO2 hydrogenation to methanol (CO2 + 3 H2 -> CH3OH + H2O)' --build meoh
hand_reference: NCE methanol model (data/meoh/meoh_d01_model.py, meoh_general_model.py): 26/63 with lab conversion held fixed (19/63 above 5 %) and 21/63 with conversion raised to 0.95 X_eq (10/63 above 5 %); both reported
